protocol_answers.1_alpha_hypothesis: ranking/selection: replace broad-market candidates with extreme trailing 60-day SPY beta because they may be hidden beta rather than idiosyncratic leadership.
protocol_answers.2_past_similar_experiments: Broad-market price-floor, rank-notional, low-extension ret5, high-volatility, trend-persistence, score-gap crowding, and selected-name correlation crowding were tested. A ticker-to-SPY beta cap was not formalized for this sleeve.

protocol_answers.4_acceptance: Gate 4 requires positive aggregate EV/PnL, all 3 windows EV-positive, no EV/PnL regression windows, >=4 replacements across >=2 windows, concentration guard, <=0.5pp max drawdown worsening, identity control, and >=10% aggregate EV improvement due frozen-sample broad-market governance retune risk.
